bugs.name: Pagure migration options remain disabled after mirror mode is cleared
bugs.summary: Enabling and then disabling mirror mode on the Pagure migration form leaves all migration-item controls disabled.
bugs.expected: Clearing mirror mode should re-enable the Issues, Pull requests, Labels, and Milestones options.
bugs.actual: After toggling This repository will be a mirror on and back off, that checkbox is unchecked but all four migration-item checkboxes remain disabled.
reproSteps: Sign in and open New migration > Pagure.
Observe that migration-item checkboxes are initially available.
Check This repository will be a mirror, then uncheck it.
Observe that Issues, Pull requests, Labels, and Milestones remain disabled.

bugs.name: Malformed Pagure URL shows an unrelated local repository restriction
bugs.summary: An invalid Pagure URL displays a local repository restriction banner alongside the field validation error.
bugs.expected: The migration form should report only validation relevant to the malformed URL.
bugs.actual: Submitting not-a-url shows both “Incorrect source repository URL” and “You are not allowed to import local repositories.”
reproSteps: Sign in and open New migration > Pagure.
Enter not-a-url as the project URL and a unique repository name.
Submit and inspect the field error and page banner.

bugs.name: Blank required repository name creates a migration destination
bugs.summary: Gitea migration accepts a blank required Repository name and creates a destination from the source URL.
bugs.expected: Submitting a migration with a blank required name should show validation and create no destination.
bugs.actual: The name input remained blank, yet Migrate repository navigated to a newly created source-derived repository and began migration.
reproSteps: Sign in and open New migration > Gitea.
Enter a Gitea clone URL while leaving Repository name blank.
Click Migrate repository and observe that a destination repository is created.

bugs.name: OneDev migration rejects a public repository clone URL as an invalid path
bugs.summary: Migrating the public OneDev server repository with its clone URL fails with invalid path.
bugs.expected: A supported OneDev migration should accept a valid public OneDev repository clone URL or give actionable input guidance.
bugs.actual: Migrating https://code.onedev.io/onedev/server.git creates a failed destination showing “invalid path: /onedev/server.git”.
reproSteps: Sign in and open New migration > OneDev.
Enter https://code.onedev.io/onedev/server.git and a unique destination repository name.
Submit and inspect the failed migration error.
